about.description: Single-stock perpetual market tracking Apple Inc. The contract gives synthetic exposure to Apple’s share price without ownership of Apple shares, shareholder rights, or dividend claims. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDH. The market is visible on Hyperliquid under the km namespace, but it is operated by Markets by Kinetiq rather than listed as a core Hyperliquid perp.
